focus-stacking-calculator.overlapDescription: Percentage of depth of field overlap between adjacent shots to ensure seamless blending
focus-stacking-calculator.tooFewShots: Depth range is within a single shot — no stacking needed
focus-stacking-calculator.tooManyShots: This plan requires many shots. Consider a narrower aperture to reduce the count.
focus-stacking-calculator.diffractionWarning: At f/{aperture}, diffraction is softening the image on this sensor. Consider a wider aperture — the stack provides the depth.
focus-stacking-calculator.diffractionWarningMacro: At {magnification}×, f/{aperture} acts like f/{effective}. Stay at f/{max} or wider for maximum sharpness.
focus-stacking-calculator.coverageWarning: The shot cap was reached before covering the full range. Use a narrower range, more depth of field per shot, or split the stack.
focus-stacking-calculator.hyperfocalHint: A single shot focused at the hyperfocal distance ({distance}) covers this entire range — no stacking needed.
